system.description: Use Putrefaction, Withering, or Necrosis as normal, but you may delay the actual effect for a number of months equal to your Physical Traits divided by three (round up). At any point within that window you may spend a Blood Trait to trigger the dormant power; if the time limit passes unused, the effect fades harmlessly.
system.duration: Delay of months equal to Physical Traits divided by three, round up
